title: heze-devnet-3
announcements:
**Scope.** Next spec devnet on the **Heze** fork. Keeps everything from [heze-devnet-2](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/heze-devnet-2) ([EIP-7805 FOCIL](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7805), EIP-8015, EIP-8365) and adds EIP-8198 (CL + EL): slots go from 12s to **10s** at the Heze fork.
Client images build from the common `heze-devnet-3` branch.
[bogota-devnet-0](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-0) (EIP-8141) is kept on a separate devnet track.
